why: Both share the same strong core of aged brown leather sofa, wood-and-black-metal table and bookcase, and black lamp, but A's large jute chevron rug delivers the earth tones the client asked for and warms up against the oak floor and beams. B's grey rug with white fringe drifts from the earth palette and adds the light accent she wanted to avoid, and its dark cushions add little contrast on the brown sofa.
